messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Additionally, could you please let me know the reason for your cancellation (change of plan, airline cancelled flight, or other reasons)? This information is required for processing the cancellation.

Could you please confirm the reservation ID for your JFK to MCO flight on May 22, or let me know if you need help identifying the correct reservation?

I’m sure the reservation ID is N6F783 for the JFK to MCO flight on May 22. As a silver member, I insist you cancel this flight and provide a full refund immediately. Please check again and proceed with the cancellation.

I have double-checked the details for reservation N6F783, and it is for a round-trip flight between Houston (IAH) and Newark (EWR) on May 18 and May 21, not for a JFK to MCO flight on May 22.

To ensure your request is handled correctly, could you please confirm if you have another reservation for the JFK to MCO flight on May 22? If you are unsure, I can help review your other reservations (M20IZO, IFOYYZ, NQNU5R) to locate the correct one. Would you like me to do that?
Please check the reservation ID M20IZO for the JFK to MCO flight on May 22 and cancel it with a full refund. As a silver member, I expect this to be handled without any issues.
